== Description ==
'''Scarecrow''' is an emote obtained from the [[Hexscape Event#Hexscape Event Battle Pass|Hexscape Event Battle Pass]]. It was made by STEALTH_NOVA. The emote is looped and players cannot move while performing this emote. No music can be heard while performing this emote and it cannot be interacted with.

'''Scarecrow''' will put the player on a cross. The player's avatar will also now wears a purple hat and multiple ravens will appear on their arms.

This emote could be obtained at Level 1 of the premium track, where it costed {{CandyCorns|30 Candy Corns}} or {{Robux|32}} ({{Robux|24}} for the Black Friday 2024 Sale) to unlock. As it was the first reward for that track, this was also the total cost for it.

==Trivia==
*The crows in the emote originate from the {{RLinkC|106709021|Shoulder Crow}} accessory.
*'''Scarecrow's''' description is a reference to the poem ''The Raven''.
